headline: Google Vids upgrades AI voiceovers with Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS

verified_story_context.summary: Google Workspace says Google Vids is moving AI voiceovers and avatar narration to Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS to improve naturalness, pacing, context-aware emphasis, and generation latency for faster script and narration iteration.
verified_story_context.why_it_matters: Better narration quality and faster revision can make AI-assisted video more practical for routine training, presentations, explainers, and other knowledge-work communication.

visual.layout: Professional white-background textbook workflow with one dominant horizontal pipeline: Script → Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS → Narrated audio → Preview & revise → Google Vids timeline. Include one clear feedback arrow from Preview & revise back to Script/TTS.
visual.mechanism: A script enters Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite text-to-speech; narration is generated with naturalness, pacing and context-aware emphasis controls; audio is previewed; revisions loop back to script/TTS; approved narration is placed in the Google Vids timeline.
visual.alt_text: Textbook workflow showing Script moving through Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS to Narrated audio, then Preview & revise with a feedback loop, and final placement in a Google Vids timeline.
